items.exampleEn: My father cooks dinner every day.
She has a busy social life.
We eat dinner together every night.
items.exampleZh: 我們每天晚上一起吃晚餐。

items.audioEn: I meet my friends every Friday. We play basketball together.
items.audioZh: 我每個星期五和朋友見面，我們一起打籃球。
items.questionZh: 說話者每週五和朋友做什麼？

items.sentenceEn: My mother and father work together.

items.stemEn: I want you to ____ my parents.
My brother and I often play ____.
items.stemZh: 我和我哥哥常常一起玩。

items.passageEn: Amy has a small family. She lives with her father, her mother, and her little brother. Every Sunday, they eat lunch together. Amy is a social person. She has many friends, and she often meets them after work.
items.passageZh: Amy 的家人不多。她和爸爸、媽媽還有弟弟住在一起。每個星期天，他們一起吃午餐。Amy 很喜歡社交，她有很多朋友，下班後常常和他們見面。

questions.questionZh: Amy 下班後常常做什麼？

items.promptZh: 我們家每個星期天一起吃午餐。
referenceEn: My family eats lunch together every Sunday.
We have lunch together on Sundays.
rubricZh: 「一起」用 together（例如 eat lunch together）
family 當主詞時動詞可用 eats 或 eat；用 We 當主詞也正確
「每個星期天」可寫 every Sunday、on Sundays、on Sunday 等

items.instructionZh: 用 friend 造一個句子，介紹你的一位朋友。
referenceEn: My friend Ken is a teacher.
rubricZh: 可用 my friend 接名字（例如 my friend Ken），或寫 … is my friend、I have a friend… 等
動詞配合主詞（例如 Ken is、I have）
